description: This source file defines the `ExecApprovalEvaluation` struct and the `ExecApprovalEvaluator` enum. The struct models the evaluation result of a command approval process, including security checks and agent attributes. The enum provides static methods to evaluate command approvals asynchronously, determine if a skill is auto-allowed based on trust policies, and is likely used in a command execution approval framework within the project.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluation
classes.description: A data structure holding the result of evaluating a command approval, including details like command, display string, agent ID, security policy, ask policy, environment, resolution details, allowlist info, and whether skill auto-allowance applies.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates whether a command is approved given various context parameters, returning an `ExecApprovalEvaluation` object encapsulating all relevant decision info.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a list of command resolutions are all trusted based on known trusted binary paths.

methods.name: _testIsSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Internal test method for `isSkillAutoAllowed`, likely used in unit tests.
